result_class: HELD-OUT TEST RESULT, measured once. Six held-out CHAOS patients under synthetic low-dose-like degradation; five predeclared training seeds per learned architecture, each seed's frozen checkpoint scored exactly once. Descriptive: no significance test, no confidence interval, no best seed.
unit_of_analysis: patient within each method-seed; then statistical training seed for the learned architectures. The six patients and five seeds are never pooled.

deterministic_methods.training_seed_variability: not applicable: both are deterministic methods, measured once. No seed standard deviation exists for them and none is reported.

full_mae.oriented_improvement_definition: unet - cnn for higher-is-better metrics, cnn - unet for lower-is-better; positive always means the U-Net did better

full_mse.oriented_improvement_definition: unet - cnn for higher-is-better metrics, cnn - unet for lower-is-better; positive always means the U-Net did better

full_psnr.oriented_improvement_definition: unet - cnn for higher-is-better metrics, cnn - unet for lower-is-better; positive always means the U-Net did better

body_ssim.oriented_improvement_definition: unet - cnn for higher-is-better metrics, cnn - unet for lower-is-better; positive always means the U-Net did better

overall.statement: The unet was directionally consistent across training seeds on all 8 metrics.
overall.note: Descriptive only. Five seeds measure the spread of this training procedure on fixed data; no p-value, significance claim or confidence interval is reported, and none is implied.

validation_to_test.note: Describes whether held-out figures were numerically higher or lower than the development figures. It is not a generalization-error estimate, and no difference here is called significant or attributed to a shift.

claim_rules.template: On six held-out CHAOS patients with synthetic low-dose-like degradation, the <architecture> improved <metric> by X over the degraded input, averaged across five predeclared training seeds.
claim_rules.all_five_seeds_phrase_requires: every one of the five seeds improved that metric over degraded
forbidden: generalizes to other scanners or institutions

overall_architecture_statement.otherwise: report the pattern metric by metric

interpretation_rules.note: Descriptive, not causal. The U-Net and the CNN differ in parameter count, receptive field, pooling, decoder and skip connections all at once, so no difference is attributed to any one of them.
